Regions / Algorithms and Coding

Algorithms and Coding

Coming soon

Students design, write, test, and debug programs on paper, then run them by hand, from first sequences and loops to complete projects.

Topics

  • Sequences, loops, and conditionals
  • Variables and data types
  • Functions
  • Testing and debugging
  • Program design
Find it on the map

Activity ideas

Unplugged ideas for each topic, to be written up as full activities.

  • Grid Robots · Sequences, loops, and conditionals

    On a floor or paper grid, students program a classmate with arrow cards, then add repeat and if cards to shorten their programs.

  • Box Tracing · Variables and data types

    Labeled envelopes stand for variables; students trace a paper program step by step, swapping the slips inside.

  • Dance Functions · Functions

    The class names a sequence of moves, then calls it by name, with inputs, to build a longer routine.

  • Bug Hunt · Testing and debugging

    Pairs run printed programs that contain planted bugs, write test cases, and fix the steps.

  • Paper Prototype · Program design

    Groups design an app on index cards, one screen per card; classmates test it by tapping the cards while a designer swaps them.

Activities

Full activities for this region are being written. Each will be unplugged, with a teacher guide and print-ready handouts, and students will need no technology.
